matrix_role: unemployment-insurance integrity, access, identity, payment-hold, overpayment, waiver, appeal, and modernization anti-theater tests

UI-01.fail_or_repair: Create a claim-state map before scoring a claim as paid, denied, fraudulent, or overpaid.
UI-01.label: Claim-state split
pass_evidence: state map visible to staff and claimant helpers
payment / denial status is not used as a substitute for issue state
UI-01.question: Does the record separate monetary eligibility, separation issue, continuing eligibility, identity status, certification, fraud suspicion, payment state, overpayment, waiver, and appeal state?

UI-02.fail_or_repair: Add identity-route ledger and preserve entitlement action outside the credential provider.
UI-02.label: Identity proofing route preservation
UI-02.question: Can failed, pending, inconclusive, digital, in-person, and non-digital identity routes be distinguished, and does each preserve claim date, certification, appeal, and payment if eligible?

UI-03.fail_or_repair: Replace generic pending / hold status with payment-hold reason, cure, and release ledger.
UI-03.label: Payment hold reason and cure clock
UI-03.question: Does every payment hold identify the specific unresolved issue, evidence reviewed, missing proof, notice, cure route, clock, and appeal path?

UI-04.fail_or_repair: Pair stopped-dollar metrics with valid-claimant harm and false-positive telemetry.
UI-04.label: Fraud-signal and false-positive telemetry
UI-04.question: Are fraud signals, confidence, referrals, confirmed fraud, cleared flags, false positives, delay, abandonment, and eventual payment outcomes measured together?

UI-05.fail_or_repair: Add employer / wage / separation issue states before treating delay as claimant ineligibility or fraud.
UI-05.label: Employer / separation issue routing
UI-05.question: Does the system distinguish claimant eligibility problems from employer nonresponse, separation disputes, wage-record issues, and adjudication delays?

UI-06.fail_or_repair: Do not collect or report recovery totals until fraud, nonfraud, waiver, appeal, and identity-theft states are separated.
UI-06.label: Overpayment classification and waiver
UI-06.question: Can overpayments be split into fraudulent, nonfraudulent, agency-caused, claimant-caused, employer-caused, identity-theft-related, appeal-pending, waived, recovered, and outstanding states?

UI-07.fail_or_repair: Add appeal and retroactive-payment receipts to the UI performance surface.
UI-07.label: Appeal and retroactive-payment receipt
pass_evidence: outcome, reversal, retroactive payment, and debt correction
UI-07.question: Are redetermination, hearing, appeal, reversal, waiver, late cure, and retroactive payment outcomes treated as delivery metrics?

UI-08.fail_or_repair: Create an identity-theft victim repair lane separate from ordinary claimant debt collection.
UI-08.label: Identity-theft victim remediation
UI-08.question: Can identity-theft victims report misuse, stop recovery, correct tax / benefit records, and preserve their own eligibility without navigating the original fraudster's claim file?

UI-09.fail_or_repair: Treat modernization artifacts as scaffolding until state performance and claimant outcomes are measured.
UI-09.label: State IT performance and modernization evidence
pass_evidence: task completion / processing error / timeliness metrics
UI-09.question: Are modernization grants, pilots, standards, open-source components, and identity services tied to measured state IT performance and claimant outcomes?

UI-10.fail_or_repair: Publish paired integrity / access metrics before claiming UI repair.
UI-10.label: Paired integrity and access public metrics
pass_evidence: public definitions for fraud, improper payment, overpayment, waiver, and access burden
UI-10.question: Does public reporting pair improper-payment, fraud, recovery, and prosecution evidence with timeliness, hold reasons, access channels, appeal outcomes, false positives, and claimant-group burden?

UI-11.fail_or_repair: Do not treat claim counts, portal completion, post-transaction surveys, or call-center dashboards as claimant access proof until non-user and burden denominators are explicit.
UI-11.label: Claimant burden and non-user denominator
pass_evidence: sample or observation protocol includes completed, delayed, denied, abandoned, assisted, non-digital, and never-completed journeys
burden measures include time, document gathering, waiting, travel, stress/cognitive load, lost certifications, and out-of-pocket costs
subgroup and channel denominators are stated with limitations instead of being absorbed into aggregate claim counts
UI-11.question: Does the packet measure claimant burden, abandonment, assisted-digital sufficiency, non-digital access, subgroup experience, and people who never reached the formal claim or survey surface?

UI-12.fail_or_repair: Do not score a waiver form, appeal right, identity-theft route, or release instruction as repair until the claimant-level money/debt/status consequence changed.
UI-12.label: Remedy-completion and retroactive-payment receipt
pass_evidence: held or denied claim is followed through cure acceptance, redetermination, appeal, waiver, or identity-theft correction
retroactive payment, certification restoration, refund, debt removal, recovery pause, or corrected notice is evidenced as completed
remaining harm, interest, tax consequence, collection tail, or unresolved appeal is recorded instead of closing the case by status label
UI-12.question: When a valid claimant is delayed, held, denied, overpaid, identity-blocked, appealed, or waived, can the packet show completed repair rather than only remedy availability?
